queries.name: roles_defaults_policies
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',rolname,'superuser',rolsuper,'inherit',rolinherit,'create_role',rolcreaterole,'create_db',rolcreatedb,'login',rolcanlogin,'replication',rolreplication,'bypass_rls',rolbypassrls,'connection_limit',rolconnlimit) ORDER BY rolname) FROM pg_roles) AS roles, (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',pg_get_userbyid(roleid),'member',pg_get_userbyid(member),'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(grantor),'admin_option',admin_option,'inherit_option',inherit_option,'set_option',set_option) ORDER BY roleid,member) FROM pg_auth_members) AS memberships, (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',pg_get_userbyid(d.defaclrole),'schema',CASE WHEN d.defaclnamespace=0 THEN NULL ELSE n.nspname END,'object_type',d.defaclobjtype,'acl',d.defaclacl::text) ORDER BY d.defaclrole,d.defaclnamespace,d.defaclobjtype) FROM pg_default_acl d LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=d.defaclnamespace) AS default_acls, (SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) ORDER BY schemaname,tablename,policyname) FROM pg_policies p WHERE schemaname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND schemaname<>'information_schema') AS policies

queries.name: effective_privileges
queries.sql: SELECT r.rolname AS role,n.nspname AS schema,c.relname AS relation,c.relkind AS kind,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'USAGE') AS schema_usage,has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'CREATE') AS schema_create,CASE WHEN c.relkind<>'S' THEN has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'SELECT') END AS select,CASE WHEN c.relkind<>'S' THEN has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'INSERT') END AS insert,CASE WHEN c.relkind<>'S' THEN has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'UPDATE') END AS update,CASE WHEN c.relkind<>'S' THEN has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'DELETE') END AS delete,CASE WHEN c.relkind<>'S' THEN has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'TRUNCATE') END AS truncate,CASE WHEN c.relkind<>'S' THEN has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'REFERENCES') END AS references,CASE WHEN c.relkind<>'S' THEN has_table_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'TRIGGER') END AS trigger,CASE WHEN c.relkind='S' THEN has_sequence_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'USAGE') END AS sequence_usage,CASE WHEN c.relkind='S' THEN has_sequence_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'SELECT') END AS sequence_select,CASE WHEN c.relkind='S' THEN has_sequence_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'UPDATE') END AS sequence_update FROM pg_roles r CROSS JOIN pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE r.rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','S','f') ORDER BY r.rolname,n.nspname,c.relname

queries.name: sequences_types_triggers
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',c.relname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),'type',format_type(s.seqtypid,NULL),'start',s.seqstart,'increment',s.seqincrement,'min',s.seqmin,'max',s.seqmax,'cache',s.seqcache,'cycle',s.seqcycle,'acl',c.relacl::text) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname) FROM pg_sequence s JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=s.seqrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema') AS sequences,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'name',t.typname,'kind',t.typtype,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(t.typowner),'acl',t.typacl::text,'base_type',CASE WHEN t.typbasetype<>0 THEN format_type(t.typbasetype,t.typtypmod) END,'not_null',t.typnotnull,'default',t.typdefault,'enum_labels',(SELECT jsonb_agg(e.enumlabel ORDER BY e.enumsortorder) FROM pg_enum e WHERE e.enumtypid=t.oid)) ORDER BY n.nspname,t.typname) FROM pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema' AND t.typtype IN ('e','d')) AS types,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'relation',c.relname,'name',t.tgname,'enabled',t.tgenabled,'internal',t.tgisinternal,'function_schema',pn.nspname,'function',p.proname,'definition',CASE WHEN n.nspname='public' THEN pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) END) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname,t.tgname) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_proc p ON p.oid=t.tgfoid JOIN pg_namespace pn ON pn.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema') AS triggers,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',e.extname,'version',e.extversion,'schema',n.nspname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(e.extowner)) ORDER BY e.extname) FROM pg_extension e JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=e.extnamespace) AS extensions

queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'schema',n.nspname,'usage',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'USAGE'),'create',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,n.oid,'CREATE')) ORDER BY r.rolname,n.nspname) FROM pg_roles r CROSS JOIN pg_namespace n WHERE r.rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema') AS schema_privileges,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'schema',n.nspname,'relation',c.relname,'any_select',has_any_column_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'SELECT'),'any_insert',has_any_column_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'INSERT'),'any_update',has_any_column_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'UPDATE'),'any_references',has_any_column_privilege(r.oid,c.oid,'REFERENCES')) ORDER BY r.rolname,n.nspname,c.relname) FROM pg_roles r CROSS JOIN pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE r.rolname IN ('anon','authenticated') AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema') AS column_privileges,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('owner',r.rolname,'object_type',k.kind,'builtin_global_acl',acldefault(k.kind,r.oid)::text,'explicit_global_acl',d.defaclacl::text) ORDER BY r.rolname,k.kind) FROM pg_roles r CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('r'::"char"),('S'::"char"),('f'::"char"),('T'::"char"),('n'::"char")) AS k(kind) LEFT JOIN pg_default_acl d ON d.defaclrole=r.oid AND d.defaclnamespace=0 AND d.defaclobjtype=k.kind WHERE r.rolname IN ('postgres','supabase_admin','supabase_auth_admin','supabase_realtime_admin','supabase_storage_admin')) AS global_default_privileges

queries.name: safe_settings_publications_dependencies
queries.sql: SELECT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AS captured_at,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('database',CASE WHEN s.setdatabase=0 THEN NULL ELSE d.datname END,'role',CASE WHEN s.setrole=0 THEN NULL ELSE pg_get_userbyid(s.setrole) END,'setting',cfg.setting) ORDER BY s.setdatabase,s.setrole,cfg.setting) FROM pg_db_role_setting s LEFT JOIN pg_database d ON d.oid=s.setdatabase CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(s.setconfig) AS cfg(setting) WHERE split_part(cfg.setting,'=',1) IN ('search_path','pgrst.db_schemas','pgrst.db_extra_search_path','pgrst.db_pre_request')) AS safe_role_database_settings,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',name,'setting',setting,'source',source) ORDER BY name) FROM pg_settings WHERE name IN ('search_path','pgrst.db_schemas','pgrst.db_extra_search_path','pgrst.db_pre_request')) AS safe_current_settings,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',pubname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(pubowner),'all_tables',puballtables,'insert',pubinsert,'update',pubupdate,'delete',pubdelete,'truncate',pubtruncate) ORDER BY pubname) FROM pg_publication) AS publications,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('publication',pubname,'schema',schemaname,'table',tablename,'columns',attnames,'rowfilter_present',rowfilter IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY pubname,schemaname,tablename) FROM pg_publication_tables) AS publication_tables,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('sequence_schema',n.nspname,'sequence',c.relname,'table_schema',tn.nspname,'table',tc.relname,'column',a.attname,'dependency_type',d.deptype) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname) FROM pg_depend d JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=d.objid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace JOIN pg_class tc ON tc.oid=d.refobjid JOIN pg_namespace tn ON tn.oid=tc.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attribute a ON a.attrelid=tc.oid AND a.attnum=d.refobjsubid WHERE d.classid='pg_class'::regclass AND d.refclassid='pg_class'::regclass AND c.relkind='S' AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema') AS sequence_dependencies

queries.name: database_types_relation_details
queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT jsonb_build_object('name',datname,'owner',pg_get_userbyid(datdba),'acl',datacl::text) FROM pg_database WHERE datname=current_database()) AS database_metadata,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'schema',n.nspname,'type',t.typname,'usage',has_type_privilege(r.oid,t.oid,'USAGE')) ORDER BY r.rolname,n.nspname,t.typname) FROM pg_roles r CROSS JOIN pg_type t JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=t.typnamespace WHERE r.rolname IN ('anon','authenticated','service_role') AND t.typtype IN ('e','d') AND n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema') AS type_privileges,(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('schema',n.nspname,'relation',c.relname,'persistence',c.relpersistence,'replica_identity',c.relreplident,'is_partition',c.relispartition,'partition_key',CASE WHEN c.relkind='p' THEN pg_get_partkeydef(c.oid) END,'partition_bound',CASE WHEN c.relispartition THEN pg_get_expr(c.relpartbound,c.oid) END,'view_definition',CASE WHEN n.nspname='public' AND c.relkind IN ('v','m') THEN pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true) END) ORDER BY n.nspname,c.relname) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND n.nspname<>'information_schema' AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','m','f')) AS relation_details
